agent_explanation: Energy blow-up occurs on first inter-body collision when masses are very unequal. At step 6 bodies are separate with energy ~1790 J (conserved). At step 7 they collide (gap 0.046) and the heavy body (m=16.94, initially at rest) acquires ~51 m/s while light body retains ~45 m/s, raising total energy to ~23888 J (>12x allowed) and momentum from -47.9 to -787, indicating impulse/velocity update scales with mass incorrectly (momentum not conserved, energy created). Equalizing masses eliminates the bug, confirming mass-ratio dependent collision impulse error.
